imagery.observation: undisturbed — no pads visible, construction not yet started
active construction — extensive graded turbine pads + access road network across project footprint, both Throckmorton and Haskell portions

cod_assessment.reasoning: Civil works (pads + roads) visible as of 2026-06 but no tower erection visible at 10m/px. Typical wind farm civil-to-COD timeline is 12-18 months. First pads appeared sometime between 2026-01 and 2026-06, putting COD no earlier than Q1 2027 if pace is aggressive and more likely Q3-Q4 2027 or slipping to 2028. 9 prior COD slips (6-year total drift) indicate chronic schedule pressure. PUCT IA schedule not retrieved (portal blocked). Ch.313 value limitation starting Jan 2028 creates incentive to achieve COD before that date but is not a hard constraint.
